map.由焦距求透镜光焦度（屈光度）: Optical power (dioptres) of a lens from its focal length
map.输入焦距 f（米），求光焦度。: Enter the focal length f (metres) to get the optical power.
map.📖 查看「由焦距求透镜光焦度（屈光度） 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Optical power (dioptres) of a lens from its focal length" guide
map.P 为正为会聚、负为发散。: P is positive for converging and negative for diverging.
map.透镜焦距与屈光力对应。: Correspondence between lens focal length and refractive power.
map.老花/近视片度数设计。: Designing powers for presbyopia and myopia lenses.
map.P=1/f=1/0.5=2D（200 度）。近视片为负屈光度、远视片为正。: P=1/f=1/0.5=2D (200 degrees). Myopia lenses are negative dioptres, hyperopia lenses positive.
map.P=1/(−0.5)=−2D；物在无穷远成像于视网膜前 0.5m 处。: P=1/(−0.5)=−2D; an object at infinity images 0.5m in front of the retina.
map.度与 D 怎么换算？: How do degrees and D convert?
map.1D=100 度；−2D 即近视 200 度镜片。: 1D=100 degrees, so −2D is a lens for 200 degrees of myopia.
map.两片叠戴总度数？: What is the total power of two lenses worn together?
map.薄镜片密接时屈光度相加：P=P1+P2。: For thin lenses in contact the powers add: P=P1+P2.
map.透镜光焦度：P = 1 ÷ f（D，f 为焦距米）；联动量：百分度 = P×10: Lens optical power: P = 1 ÷ f (D, f in meters); linked values: centidiopters = P×100, focal length in cm = f×100, reciprocal focal length = 1 ÷ max(|P|,10⁻⁹)×1000 (mm), millidiopters = P ÷ 1000. Validation: f is guarded as non-empty; f = 0 reports "The denominator cannot be 0" and all-zero input errors. Criteria: no fixed grading; positive f gives P>0 (converging), negative f gives P<0 (diverging).
